meta.summary: Manufacturing company with 501-2000 employees in experimenting maturity; envelopes set at 0.5x sector median to govern early AI adoption with strict controls.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable; all AI subscriptions must be procured through the approved vendor process with CFO sign-off.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn reaches 72% before month midpoint
Team envelope burn exceeds 90% with more than 5 days remaining in month
Company envelope burn reaches 100% before month end

rationales.e1: Support usage on an allowlisted provider, inside its monthly envelope. Approved.
rationales.e2: Data usage on an allowlisted provider, inside its monthly envelope. Approved.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 20% variance band; likely cause is a model version upgrade or prompt expansion in the deploy that doubled token consumption per call.
rationales.e4: Marketing team has now logged its third ChatGPT Team subscription this quarter, meeting the team_subscription_threshold of 1 duplicate; all three charges are rerouted to the approved OpenAI enterprise contract.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune job estimated at $4,800 exceeds the $1,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold; CFO approval is required before the job is submitted.
rationales.e6: Autonomous research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 10 retry per task limit, and $47/hr, exceeding the $20/hr kill threshold; agent terminated immediately, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: Frontier delta of 65 against a 100 cap. Approved.
rationales.e8: Junior engineer personal API key spiked to 22x baseline with no project tag; ladder step 2 throttles the key and Engineering lead is notified within 2 hours, preserving a monitored experimentation carve-out pending tag assignment.
rationales.e9: Agent card charge of 499 against a 250 ceiling. Approval required.
rationales.e10: Design team AI video tool at $89/month overlaps with the Sales team tool at $1,400/year running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider charged 120; the new-provider rule is set to block. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to an internal tool was submitted as COGS; the internal-tool project tag rule reclassifies the charge to OpEx in accordance with the classification policy.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining exceeds the 72% burn_alert_pct; ladder step 1 alert was already triggered and step 2 throttle is now active, with CFO notified on current trajectory.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes, agent guardrails, and classification rules reconciled with no unresolved exceptions carried forward.
